review:
The tramp's rags-to-riches story continues on Trueways reels, and now there's a Coin Respin as well as free spins.

Chance x2 boosts your odds of both features, which makes it more worthwhile here. Very high volatility, 5,000x max and 96.7% RTP, with free spins about once every 229 spins. Same maths as Olympus Trueways and Wild West Trueways, with a quirky street theme.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
